_meta.notes: Cho and Gall are one in game hero (Cho'gall) with two bodies; Icy Veins and Heroes Profile list them together, so their patch stats are shared.

Abathur.strengths_note: Toxic Nest, Symbiote and Deep Tunnel wage a non stop war across the map.
Abathur.weaknesses_note: Very low personal impact and hard to learn.

Alarak.strengths_note: Discord Strike, Lightning Surge and Deadly Charge give strong single target burst.
Alarak.weaknesses_note: Demands precise ability use and has weak waveclear.

Alexstrasza.strengths_note: Gift of Life, Abundance and Dragonqueen give strong team sustain and burst.
Alexstrasza.weaknesses_note: Needs time to build heals and depends on positioning.

Ana.strengths_note: Healing Dart, Sleep Dart and Nano Boost give burst healing and pick potential at range.
Ana.weaknesses_note: Very fragile and reliant on cooldowns.

Anduin.strengths_note: Leap of Faith, Lightbomb and Divine Star give a strong pull and heal.

Anub'arak.strengths_note: Burrow Charge into Cocoon or Impale gives a reliable engage and a strong pick.
Anub'arak.weaknesses_note: Low damage and thin sustain mean he needs allies ready to follow his initiation.

extra.objective_notes: Burrow scouts and rotates but he soaks poorly

Artanis.strengths_note: Blade Dash and Phase Prism let him dive and Shield Overload keeps him alive.
Artanis.weaknesses_note: Melee and weak to CC and kiting.

Arthas.strengths_note: Frozen Tempest and Death Coil give heavy self sustain, wave clear and lane control.
Arthas.weaknesses_note: Little engage and he is easy to kite or root down.

extra.objective_notes: Strong solo laner who pushes towers well

Auriel.strengths_note: Crystal Aegis, Ray of Heaven and Resurrect offer excellent sustain.
Auriel.weaknesses_note: Low damage and slow to protect herself.

Azmodan.strengths_note: Globe of Annihilation and Demonic Invasion give elite structure damage and wave clear.
Azmodan.weaknesses_note: Zero mobility and an easy target.

Blaze.strengths_note: Flame Stream, Oil Spill and Bunker Drop give strong lane pressure from the offlane.
Blaze.weaknesses_note: Very short range and low sustain make him easy to kite and burst.

extra.objective_notes: Pushes a lane to force rotations

Brightwing.strengths_note: Phase Shift and Blink Heal make her safe and mobile.

Cassia.strengths_note: Lightning Fury, Ball Lightning and Valkyrie give flexible poke and good wave clear.
Cassia.weaknesses_note: Low defense and relies on energy and mana.

Chen.strengths_note: Flying Kick, Breath of Fire and Storm, Earth, Fire give flexible utility and solid camp clear.
Chen.weaknesses_note: Hard to learn and vulnerable to heavy burst.

extra.objective_notes: Fine at camps and boss capture

Cho.strengths_note: Upheaval, Surging Fist and Hammer of Twilight set up and win close fights.
Cho.weaknesses_note: Two player hero that suffers when the pair is not coordinated.

extra.objective_notes: Cho and Gall together soak objectives well

Chromie.strengths_note: Dragon's Breath, Sand Blast and Temporal Loop give strong burst at range.

D.Va.strengths_note: Boosters and Defense Matrix give mobility and a huge effective health pool in the mech.
D.Va.weaknesses_note: Must rebuild the mech after losing it and is punished when caught out.

Deathwing.strengths_note: Cataclysm, Molten Flame and CC immunity make him a strong sieger and global presence.
Deathwing.weaknesses_note: Cannot be healed or shielded and has slow casting animations.

extra.objective_notes: Dragonflight gives global rotations and siege

Deckard.strengths_note: Healing Potion, Horadric Cube and Lorenado offer steady sustain.

Dehaka.strengths_note: Drag, Burrow and Essence Collection make him strong at stealing camps and soloing.
Dehaka.weaknesses_note: Weak wave clear and offers little peel.

Diablo.strengths_note: Shadow Charge, Overpower and Apocalypse give strong single target and team engages.
Diablo.weaknesses_note: Little peel and his engage tools are predictable single targets.

extra.objective_notes: Fine soak but not a siege tank

E.T.C..strengths_note: Mosh Pit and Powerslide give a wide engage, Stage Dive adds global reach.
E.T.C..weaknesses_note: Must stay in melee range and has weak sustain without allies.

Falstad.strengths_note: Flight and Hammerang give global map pressure and fast rotations.
Falstad.weaknesses_note: Mana hungry and caught by CC.

Fenix.strengths_note: Weapon Modes, Shield Capacitor and Planet Cracker give strong sustained damage.
Fenix.weaknesses_note: Hard to reposition and has no peel.

Gall.strengths_note: Shadowflame and Dread Orb add strong ranged burst and wave clear to Cho.
Gall.weaknesses_note: Weak without a competent Cho and has no mobility.

Garrosh.strengths_note: Wrecking Ball and Decimate dive the backline and Armor Up makes him durable.
Garrosh.weaknesses_note: No wave clear and no mobility outside his combo.

Gazlowe.strengths_note: Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge give elite wave and structure damage.
Gazlowe.weaknesses_note: Fragile and offers little team fight impact.

Genji.strengths_note: Swift Strike and Deflect make him a high skill duelist.
Genji.weaknesses_note: Very difficult to play and easy to punish.

Greymane.strengths_note: Worgen and Human forms with Darkflight give flexibility and pick potential.
Greymane.weaknesses_note: Complicated and punished when forms are mistimed.

Gul'dan.strengths_note: Life Tap, Fel Flame and Rain of Destruction give siege and burst.
Gul'dan.weaknesses_note: Zero mobility and risk from spending health.

Hanzo.strengths_note: Scatter Arrow and Dragon's Arrow give heavy poke at long range.
Hanzo.weaknesses_note: Slow, fragile and reliant on hitting skillshots.

Hogger.strengths_note: Staggering Blow and Loot Hoard use terrain for strong CC and Hogg Wild clears waves.
Hogger.weaknesses_note: Weak to poke and mobile heroes and best in narrow lanes.

extra.objective_notes: Great at camp and boss capture

Illidan.strengths_note: Dive and Evasion give top tier mobility and Illidan excels at map pressure.
Illidan.weaknesses_note: Easy to kill if mispositioned and needs fights to be decided quickly.

Imperius.strengths_note: Valorous Brand and Molten Armor give strong sustain and brawling.

Jaina.strengths_note: Ring of Frost, Blizzard and Frostbolt give burst, CC and wave clear.

Johanna.strengths_note: Blessed Shield, Falling Sword and Iron Skin give great frontline value in brawls.
Johanna.weaknesses_note: Slow, large and weak to ranged poke.

Junkrat.strengths_note: Concussion Mine and Steel Trap zone enemies and siege strongly.
Junkrat.weaknesses_note: Low sustain and relies on trap placement.

Kael'thas.strengths_note: Flamestrike and Living Bomb give huge area burst and wave clear.

Kel'Thuzad.strengths_note: Frost Nova, Shadow Fissure and Chains of Kel'Thuzad give heavy area control.

Kerrigan.strengths_note: Ravage and Primal Grasp give strong burst and pick potential.
Kerrigan.weaknesses_note: Relies on landing abilities and has limited mobility.

Kharazim.strengths_note: Radiant Dash and Iron Fists give mobility, Divine Palm saves allies.
Kharazim.weaknesses_note: Must stay close and is hard to master.

Leoric.strengths_note: Drain Hope and Skeletal Swing give great sustain and strong damage against heroes.
Leoric.weaknesses_note: Poor mobility and easy to kite.

Li Li.strengths_note: Healing Brew, Cloud Serpent and Blinding Winds make her sustain steady.

Li-Ming.strengths_note: Teleport and Arcane Orb give high burst at range.

Lt. Morales.strengths_note: Healing Beam, Safeguard and Medivac Dropship give strong healing from range.

Lunara.strengths_note: Kiting with Nature's Toxin and Wisp wins sustained fights and sieges.
Lunara.weaknesses_note: Needs to kite constantly and has low burst.

Lúcio.strengths_note: Amp It Up, Crossfade and Sound Barrier give team speed and area heals.

Maiev.strengths_note: Spirit of Vengeance and Warden's Cage let her pick targets and escape.

Mal'Ganis.strengths_note: Vampiric Touch gives strong sustain and Night Rush catches squishies.
Mal'Ganis.weaknesses_note: Many abilities and both heroics are easy to interrupt and roots stop him.

Malfurion.strengths_note: Regrowth, Entangling Roots and Tranquility give lots of healing and CC.

Malthael.strengths_note: Wraith Strike, Soul Rip and Death Shroud give pick and team fight value.
Malthael.weaknesses_note: Lacks reliable dive and is vulnerable to CC.

Medivh.strengths_note: Portal, Raven Form and Poly Bomb add pick potential and global presence.

Mei.strengths_note: Ice Wall, Icing and Blizzard give strong zoning, lane control and poke for a tank.
Mei.weaknesses_note: Fragile for a tank and dependent on her Ice Wall combos.

Mephisto.strengths_note: Lightning Nova and Durance of Hate give strong team fight area damage.
Mephisto.weaknesses_note: Low mobility and relies on cooldowns.

Muradin.strengths_note: Storm Bolt and Dwarf Toss are easy to use and Avatar makes him hard to kill.
Muradin.weaknesses_note: Weak wave clear and falls off if his stuns miss.

Murky.strengths_note: Spawn Egg and Safety Bubble make him a hard to remove split pusher and pest.
Murky.weaknesses_note: Very weak in fights and relies on baiting.

Nazeebo.strengths_note: Zombie Wall, Corpse Spiders and Gargantuan give excellent wave clear.
Nazeebo.weaknesses_note: Slow and a poor team fighter without setup.

Nova.strengths_note: Snipe and Permanent Cloak give strong pick potential from range.
Nova.weaknesses_note: Highly dependent on landing Snipe and easy to punish.

Orphea.strengths_note: Shadow Waltz, Chomp and Crushing Jaws provide pick damage with sustain.

Probius.strengths_note: Warp In Pylon, Photon Cannon and Warp Rift create strong siege and defense.
Probius.weaknesses_note: Needs lots of setup and loses to dive.

Qhira.strengths_note: Grappling Hook and Revolving Sweep make her a mobile duelist who is hard to catch.
Qhira.weaknesses_note: Very poor wave clear and dependent on terrain.

Ragnaros.strengths_note: Empower Sulfuras, Living Meteor and Lava Wave make him one of the best sieging heroes.
Ragnaros.weaknesses_note: No mobility and weak when caught by dive.

Raynor.strengths_note: Inspire, Adrenaline Rush and Hyperion give steady auto attack damage and ally buffs.
Raynor.weaknesses_note: Low burst and easy to dive.

Rehgar.strengths_note: Ghost Wolf, Chain Heal and Lightning Shield offer heavy sustain with melee presence.
Rehgar.weaknesses_note: Moderate damage and less healing than pure healers.

Rexxar.strengths_note: Misha is a strong frontline and Rexxar clears camps with ease.
Rexxar.weaknesses_note: Weak to poke and needs to manage two bodies.

Samuro.strengths_note: Mirror Image, Wind Walk and Illusion Master are great for splitting and escaping.
Samuro.weaknesses_note: Extremely hard to master with little team fight impact.

Sgt. Hammer.strengths_note: Siege Mode pokes anything at long range and destroys structures.

extra.objective_notes: One of the best siege heroes

Sonya.strengths_note: Leap, Whirlwind and Seismic Slam give a strong brawl with sustain.
Sonya.weaknesses_note: Weak against kiting and sustained CC.

Stitches.strengths_note: Hook is a game changing pick and Devour heals him through damage.
Stitches.weaknesses_note: Hook is one skillshot and he cannot catch mobile heroes.

extra.objective_notes: Hook can steal or interrupt objectives

Stukov.strengths_note: Healing Pathogen, Weighted Pustule and Massive Shove provide poke and heal.

Sylvanas.strengths_note: Black Arrows, Haunting Wave and Mind Control give strong wave clear and siege.
Sylvanas.weaknesses_note: Weak to dive and low burst.

Tassadar.strengths_note: Force Wall, Shock Ray and Archon provide poke and peel for allies.
Tassadar.weaknesses_note: Lower damage early and Archon is a commitment.

The Butcher.strengths_note: Ruthless Onslaught and Lamb to the Slaughter give heavy single target dive.
The Butcher.weaknesses_note: Poor sustain and he is easy to kite.

The Lost Vikings.strengths_note: Three bodies, Longboat Raid and Viking Hoard create map control.
The Lost Vikings.weaknesses_note: Must be micromanaged and has low team fight power.

Thrall.strengths_note: Chain Lightning, Feral Spirit and Windfury give lane pressure and camp clear.
Thrall.weaknesses_note: Lacks burst early and has to be near targets.

Tracer.strengths_note: Blink and Recall make her very hard to kill.
Tracer.weaknesses_note: Low damage and range and demands high skill.

Tychus.strengths_note: Minigun and Commandeer Odin give strong sustained damage.
Tychus.weaknesses_note: Slow mobility and weak to dive.

Tyrael.strengths_note: Sanctification and Judgment protect allies and El'druin's Might gives global reach.
Tyrael.weaknesses_note: Does not start fights alone and loses value away from allies.

extra.objective_notes: El'druin's Might lets him join far fights

Tyrande.strengths_note: Sentinel, Lunar Flare and Shadowstalk add poke and pick damage while healing.
Tyrande.weaknesses_note: Less healing than dedicated healers and fragile.

Uther.strengths_note: Holy Light, Hammer of Justice and Divine Shield give big heals, a stun and protection.
Uther.weaknesses_note: Limited mobility and vulnerable to dive.

Valeera.strengths_note: Vanish, Cheap Shot and Garrote provide strong pick and flank potential.
Valeera.weaknesses_note: Short burst windows and punished by area damage or detection.

Valla.strengths_note: Hungering Arrow, Vault and Strafe offer mobility and burst.
Valla.weaknesses_note: Low sustain and reliant on position.

Varian.strengths_note: Charge, Taunt and Colossus Smash let him flex between dive and frontline.
Varian.weaknesses_note: Does not excel at any one thing and has poor wave clear.

Whitemane.strengths_note: Desperate Plea, Scarlet Aegis and Divine Reckoning give flexible healing at range.
Whitemane.weaknesses_note: Low defense and reliant on cooldowns.

Xal'atath.strengths_note: Shadow Mark and Dark Heart Ritual bring burst and area damage with Void Step repositioning.
Xal'atath.weaknesses_note: Very fragile and has a steep learning curve.

Xul.strengths_note: Raise Skeleton, Bone Armor and Cursed Strikes give lane control and sustained damage.
Xul.weaknesses_note: Fragile when skeletons are dead and weak to CC.

Yrel.strengths_note: Righteous Hammer and Ardent Defender give sustain and Vindication supports allies.

Zagara.strengths_note: Creep Tumors, Hunter Killer and Nydus Network give elite wave clear and map pressure.
Zagara.weaknesses_note: Low team fight impact and fragile.

Zarya.strengths_note: Personal Barrier, Shield Ally and Graviton Surge give strong team protection.
Zarya.weaknesses_note: Poor wave clear and weak against kiting.

Zeratul.strengths_note: Blink and Permanent Cloak give top mobility and map presence, Void Prison wins picks.
Zeratul.weaknesses_note: Fragile and punished by detection and misses.

Zul'jin.strengths_note: Berserker, Twin Cleave and Taz'dingo provide heavy sustained damage.
Zul'jin.weaknesses_note: Low mobility and punished by CC.
